_readme: The questions worth answering without a model call.
These are the ones a congress asks in bursts — at registration, at the end of a
session, at the start of a coffee break — where everyone wants the same handful of
facts within the same two minutes. Groq's free tier allows about one request a
minute, so those bursts are exactly what the assistant cannot serve live.
It answers each one through the real prompt and the real retrieval, writes
data/warm-answers.json, and skips anything already answered so it can be run in
chunks. READ THE ANSWERS BEFORE COMMITTING — once shipped they are served
verbatim, with nothing downstream able to catch a bad one.
Add questions as the committee learns what people actually ask; the unanswered-
question log (wrangler tail) is the place to look.
